hearing.quote: Renewal means West Oakland businesses and residents, 23 days on the clock, and a closeout record on the table before council votes.
hearing.actionAsked: Support placing the $28M charter renewal on this cycle's council agenda only with West Oakland business-and-resident scope and the 23-day processing standard intact, and require the ordered C114 closeout publication in the hearing record before a final renewal decision.

hearing.quote: A Laurel cleanup becomes real through a defined scope, resident outreach, and a Clerk entry neighbors can verify for themselves.
hearing.actionAsked: YES on keeping Laurel cleanup drafting and Clerk-verified filing on this cycle's required agenda; INIT-015 remains announced, not filed, and a missed verification gets recorded as a missed deadline.

hearing.quote: A review should begin with a filing the Clerk can verify, not an assertion that one exists.
hearing.actionAsked: Hold the filed-legislation review until the Clerk supplies a verifiable filing reference.

hearing.quote: A charter extension cannot outpace the ledger; we must verify audited closeout documentation before committing city resources.
hearing.actionAsked: Condition any charter renewal vote on publication and verification of the C114 closeout ledger and preservation of the 23-day processing standard.

hearing.quote: A stated YES is not a roll call, and a proposed allocation is not an appropriation.
hearing.actionAsked: I cannot confirm that a legislative vote occurred or that Chinatown or Uptown appropriations were authorized; request the Clerk's record and correct the public account accordingly.

hearing.quote: Clinical dollars require clinical proof; an open facility does not get an exemption from delivering its quarterly audit data.
hearing.actionAsked: Require timely filing of the Q3 clinical intake audit with HCAI and the Council Clerk alongside completion of the recurring Telegraph and 47th merchant verification walkthrough before certifying operational oversight.

hearing.quote: An individual affirmative vote is not an enacted ordinance; District 8 votes YES to secure Chen-Vega fiscal controls, but final disposition rests on a certified roll call.
hearing.actionAsked: The City Clerk must record and certify the roll-call vote on INIT-009 and publish the official final decision record with all Chen-Vega audit conditions attached.

hearing.quote: East Oakland's calls are already in this program — so East Oakland's record and Fruitvale's record get published before this program expands one block.
hearing.actionAsked: Hold expansion until the D3 Fruitvale briefing record is executed and published with district-level and Fruitvale data, community participation documented, and responsible next dates filed for the still-incomplete D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review.

hearing.quote: Fruitvale gets the briefing and the numbers in the daylight — expansion waits until the audit and the Baylight review are actually done.
hearing.actionAsked: Publish the D3 briefing record with Fruitvale and district-level data, notice and accessibility arrangements, and Clerk filing references this cycle; keep expansion held until the D5 audit and Baylight review report.

dispositions.note: C116: Charter renewal kept on Council calendar; final action requires verified C114 closeout, business-and-resident scope and the 23-day standard.
C116: D3 Fruitvale briefing execution and publication directed; expansion held pending community documentation, D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review.
C116: Further design advancement held pending preliminary schematics and a documented Fruitvale public comment-and-response record.
C116: Q3 intake audit filing and Telegraph & 47th merchant walkthrough required before operational oversight is certified.
C116: No construction milestone certified; evidence-file review and independent remediation, hotline, dust-control and workforce oversight continue.
C116: Recorded stalled pending publication of the placement-gap analysis and adjustment plan, including West Oakland and Fruitvale review.
C116: Full-council decision remains vote-scheduled; certified Clerk roll call required with all Chen-Vega conditions and no outcome claimed.
C116: Legal-support analysis must precede the committee vote; no decision or funding outcome claimed pending a Clerk-recorded result.
C116: C115 filing claim is unverified; Council review held pending a Clerk docket reference or a recorded missed deadline.
C116: Legislation-filing deadline missed; INIT-015 remains announced pending scope, outreach and Clerk-verified filing.

gavel.quote: West Oakland's renewal must bring its closeout ledger, its business-and-resident charter and its 23-day standard into the same public record.
